name: honk
description: Native Omarchy bar widget and control panel for the honk transparent proxy engine: traffic in the bar; overview, groups, connections, logs and settings in the panel. Talks to honk's native API through honk-agent. Forked from sbdbar.

barWidget.description: honk proxy controller, traffic monitor, and node selector

schema.label: Native API URL
schema.description: Overrides the URL saved in the panel's Settings tab, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9527

schema.label: API Secret
schema.description: Overrides the secret saved in the panel's Settings tab (experimental.native_api.secret)

schema.label: Display traffic in bar
schema.description: Show real-time upload and download speeds in the bar widget
